region: ISO New England (EIA-930 balancing authority ISNE)

sources.name: EIA-930 Hourly Electric Grid Monitor (bulk six-month files)
sources.caveat: Hourly values include imputed and later-corrected data; real-time values are preliminary.

sources.name: Open-Meteo historical weather — Concord, NH (ERA5 reanalysis via Open-Meteo)
